pap_section_1_paragraph_1: Wilfrido tabata biba na Weg naar Welgelegen 13. Di akinan e tabata sali sea na pia òf ku bus pa bai bende su bukinan. Den komienso el a purba di tin hende pa yud’e pa distribuí su bukinan. E tabata saka anunsio den su bukinan pa wak si personanan ku tin outo, i ku lo ta dispuesto pa yud’e ku benta. Esaki, sinembargo, tabata kost’é muchu mas di loke e tabata gana for di su benta, i e a opta pa e mes distribuí su bukinan di porta pa porta.
pap_section_1_paragraph_2: “Si bo bai despues di mèrdia i bo mira ku kas ta será, sigui bai. E hendenan por ta drumí i lo no apresiá si bo lantanan for di soño.” Esaki ta un konseho ku Wilfrido a duna Rudolf Crispulo pa e mes por a bende su fotonovelanan di kas pa kas. Segun otro hendenan tabata parse ku Wilfrido ta tin su orarionan ku e ta pasa den kada bario.
pap_section_1_paragraph_3: Wilfrido ta tin alrededor di 3000 persona ku e tabata bende buki ku ne. Esaki tabata debí na un kantidat di esfuerso kreativo pa e por a bende su bukinan.
pap_section_2_paragraph_1: Wilfrido a krea un sistema ku hende por a aboná pa su bukinan. E hendenan por a registrá ku formularionan ku e tabata imprimí den su buki i pòst esaki pe. Komo miembro di N.A.D.W.O. nan por a paga un preis redusí pa su bukinan. E miembronan mes por a indiká si nan lo a paga mensual, semanal òf pa kinsena. N.A.D.W.O ta para pa Novela Amoroso Di Wilfrido Ortega.
pap_section_2_paragraph_2: Lesadonan por a asta tuma buki i paga despues. E tabata laga e klientenan ku un komprobante riba kua e tabata pone nan nòmber, adrès, dia di pago, suma di debe, fecha ku el a pasa, kuantu buki nan a paga kaba, i kuantu falta pa paga ainda. Esaki a krea ku tin hende no tabata paga e bukinan. Wilfrido su strategia tabata pa skibi e debe riba eis, i sigui pasa tòg serka e hendenan pa e no pèrdè su klientenan.
pap_section_3_paragraph_1: Komo kumpradó di buki bo por a partisipá na rifa di ‘5 y 6’. Bo por a gana pakete di buki. Den e buki ta tin e formulario, i kada formulario ta tin su mes number úniko manera nos konosé lòt awendia. E number aki ta determiná si bo ta gana. Riba e formulario den e buki Kada pan ku su keshi, bo mester a selektá un pakete ku tin e títulonan di e bukinan ku mas bo gusta. Por a selektá di 6 pakete.
pap_section_4_paragraph_1: Wilfrido a biba shete aña na Aruba i 3 na Boneiru pa aumentá su klientela na tur e islanan. Na Aruba el a indiká ku e ta tin alrededor di 450 abonado. Apesar ku niun kaminda e no ta menshoná kantidat di abonado na Boneiru, el a gradisí pueblo di Boneiru pa e manera ku nan a asept’é ora ku el a bai biba na Boneiru.
pap_section_4_paragraph_2: Na tur dos isla tambe e tabata bai di kas pa kas, pa bende su bukinan. Na Aruba por a mira den korant anunsio pa benta di e buki Destino di Amor na Sastreria La Moda.
pap_section_5_paragraph_1: For di final di 2007, Fundashon Kas di Kultura a sostene Wilfrido pa e por a bende su bukinan e.o. den librería. E mes a sigui bende manera e ta por. Debí na su edat e no por a sigui topa ku su klientenan di porta pa porta. Te ku 2021 por a topa Wilfrido huntu ku su ruman muhé Edline, na pòmp di gasolin na Juliana Dorp ta bende su bukinan.
en_section_1_paragraph_1: Wilfrido lived at Weg naar Welgelegen 13. From there he set out on foot or by bus to sell his books. At first, he tried to find people willing to help distribute them. He placed notices in his books asking for volunteers with cars who could assist with sales. The cost, however, exceeded what he earned, so he chose to distribute his books himself, door to door.
en_section_1_paragraph_2: “If you go out in the afternoon and find a house closed, keep walking. People may be sleeping and will not appreciate being woken up.” This was advice Wilfrido gave Rudolf Crispulo, who also sold his photo novels door to door. According to other accounts, Wilfrido appeared to follow a regular schedule in each neighborhood.
en_section_1_paragraph_3: Wilfrido reportedly had around 3,000 customers to whom he sold books. He used a range of creative approaches to reach them.
en_section_2_title: N.A.D.W.O. readers’ club — Take now, pay later
en_section_2_paragraph_1: Wilfrido established a subscription system for his books. Readers could register using forms printed in the books and send them to him by post. Members of N.A.D.W.O. could purchase books at reduced prices and choose to pay weekly, fortnightly or monthly. N.A.D.W.O. stood for Novela Amoroso Di Wilfrido Ortega.
en_section_2_paragraph_2: Readers could also take books and pay later. Wilfrido left customers a receipt recording their name, address, payment date, amount owed, the date of his visit, how many books had been paid for and the remaining balance. Some customers did not pay. Rather than lose them, Wilfrido sometimes wrote off the debt and continued visiting.
en_section_3_paragraph_1: Book buyers could enter the ‘5 y 6’ raffle to win packages of books. The entry form was printed in the book and carried a unique number, similar to a lottery ticket. The number determined whether a participant won. In the book Kada pan ku su keshi, readers could select their preferred book package from six options.
en_section_4_paragraph_1: Wilfrido lived for seven years in Aruba and three years in Bonaire in an effort to increase his readership across the islands. He stated that he had about 450 subscribers in Aruba. Although no subscriber figure for Bonaire is mentioned here, he expressed gratitude to the people of Bonaire for how they welcomed him.
en_section_4_paragraph_2: On both islands he went door to door to sell his books. In Aruba, a newspaper advertisement offered his book Destino di Amor for sale at Sastreria La Moda.
en_section_5_paragraph_1: From late 2007, Fundashon Kas di Kultura supported Wilfrido in selling his books, including through bookstores. He continued selling them himself as far as he was able. As he grew older, he could no longer visit customers door to door. As late as 2021, Wilfrido and his sister Edline could be found selling books at a gas station in Julianadorp.
